description: This file defines an abstract base class 'ResourceBase' for resource plugins in Drupal's REST module, including methods for permissions, route generation, and HTTP method handling.

classes.name: ResourceBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for REST resource plugins in Drupal, including permission management and route setup.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing serializer formats and logger.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the resource with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: permissions
methods.description: Generates permissions for each available method of the resource.

methods.name: routes
methods.description: Creates route collection for the resource's HTTP methods.

methods.name: requestMethods
methods.description: Provides default HTTP request methods; can be overridden.

methods.name: availableMethods
methods.description: Returns the list of HTTP methods supported by the resource.

methods.name: getBaseRoute
methods.description: Creates a route object for a specific HTTP method and path.

methods.name: getBaseRouteRequirements
methods.description: Defines access and permission requirements for a route based on HTTP method.
